limits: Actual compiled PWA, NextAuth and API routes against fresh schema-created SQLite and synthetic accounts. This does not test provisioning approval, live accounts or native PostgreSQL.

tests.name: Invalid password produces a generic mounted login failure
Forced reset blocks operations, persists a password change and returns to login
Reauthentication after reset opens the mounted PWA and sign-out clears it
A committed payment with a lost browser acknowledgement recovers its original receipt after reload
The profile directory paginates, saves only the selected profile, and returns to selectable profiles
An authenticated browser attendance write survives reload and replay without duplicate rows
Mounted PWA rejects a revoked identity on refreshed session
Mounted PWA rejects a inactive identity on refreshed session
Mounted PWA rejects a deleted identity on refreshed session
Mounted PWA rejects a scope identity on refreshed session
Revoked capability disappears from the mounted menu and the direct API denies it
